image_description: A small passerine bird, identified as a female or non-breeding male Brambling (Fringilla montifringilla), perched on a lichen-covered branch. The bird has brownish-grey upperparts with dark streaking, a buff-orange breast and flanks, and a pale belly. It features a short, conical bill and distinct wing bars. The background is a soft, out-of-focus beige.
